神秘木牌
映霞岛上，张公子与聂鹏两人正在对饮，山腹内的隋缘此时已经顺着石阶来到了第二层石室，相比于下面存放金银的地方，这里的面积却是要大了很多。
隋缘眼前，小山一般的铠甲被堆满了整个石室，在石室四周的墙壁上去，却是挂满了制式的长刀和枪矛，不止多少年过去，这些兵刃和铠甲上面仍旧没有半分的锈迹，在石室顶部夜明珠的映照下闪烁着森然的寒光。
行走在石室内，隋缘感觉自己周身的皮肤就像是被无数兵刃指着一般，鸡皮疙瘩就没停下来过。
“轰。
轰。
。”
就在隋缘来到这里不久，石室另一侧忽然传来沉重石门升起的声音，隋缘心中一惊，偏头看去，却见石门后面一道浑身包裹着黑衣的身影正站在那里。
黑衣人双眼冷冷的盯着石室中的隋缘，眼中有些疑惑，然而更多的却是冰冷的杀意。
察觉到来人的身份，知道自己不是对手，隋缘轻吸口气微微挺直了腰板，想让自己看上去没有那么害怕。
然而门口的黑衣人显然并不在意这些，站在门口环视四周，确认石室内只有隋缘一人之后，直接迈步向着隋缘走了过来。
黑衣人的脚步落在石室内的铠甲上，发出咔咔的声音，就像是催命的鼓点一样声声砸在隋缘的心里。
“你是什么人？”
强忍住心中的恐惧，隋缘向着面前的黑衣人问道。
声音中隐藏着他自己都能听出来的颤抖。
然而对面的黑衣人并未答话，在迈步走到隋缘身前一丈以内的时候，黑衣人骤然抬手一挥，袖中一点寒芒闪过，隋缘只感觉眼前一花，还没弄清楚发生了什么事情，胸口就像是被巨石砸中一般，整个人不由得向后倒飞而去。
身形重重的砸在身后的铠甲上，隋缘只感觉喉头一甜，忍不住张口喷出一股淤血。
“嗯！
？”

眼见隋缘没有被穿胸而死，黑衣人显然有些奇怪，目光在隋缘的胸口上扫过，透过衣衫，隐隐的可以看到里面有一块漆黑的吊坠模样的东西。
冷哼一声，不等隋缘站起身，黑衣人身形骤然加速上前，抬手向着隋缘的胸口按了下来。
见状不妙，隋缘不知道哪里来的力气，一招平日里打架常用的懒驴打滚，身形向进来的石门滚去。
然而双方实力相差太过悬殊，黑衣人一击不成，脚下轻点，身形再次飞掠而其，抬手间，又是两道寒芒一左一右的向着隋缘的脑袋飞来。
此时隋缘正在地上打滚，没能看到飞来的两支利器，但脑后的冷风让他下意识的向上抬头，只听“叮叮”
两声，隋缘感觉自己耳后一疼，一股温热的液体流淌了下来。
咬了咬牙，凭着多年街头斗殴的经验，隋缘心中清楚，自己耳朵后面受伤了，但伤口应该不是很严重，不然现在自己的脑袋不会如此的清醒。
生死危机之下，隋缘爆发出了此生最快的速度，几乎是连滚带爬的来到了石室的门口。
眼看着面前的石壁，只要自己跑过去，隋缘有信心能凭着落下的石门阻拦后面的黑衣人片刻，之后自己便有机会从水潭中脱身了。
然而就在隋缘左脚跨过石门的同时，身后冷风再起。
隋缘下意识的转身躲避，眼角的余光却是瞥见一道雪亮的刀光从后面横扫而来。
‘这下完了！
’隋缘心中闪过这个念头，随即胸口再次像被巨石击中一般，忍不住张口喷出一股血雾，身形装在了一侧的石门上。
看着几乎站在自己面前的黑衣人，隋缘面上露出了一抹惨笑，‘果然，自己这辈子就只是一个乞丐的命，就算是得了金银珠宝也保不住。
心中闪过这个念头，隋缘深吸口气，缓缓的闭上了双眼。
在这么近的距离下，自己绝没有逃脱的可能。

Mysterious wooden sign
On Yingxia Island, Mr. Zhang and Nie Peng were drinking together. Sui Yuan, who was in the mountain, had already followed the stone steps to the second floor of the stone chamber. Compared to the place below where the gold and silver were stored, the area here was much larger.
In front of Sui Yuan's eyes, a small mountain of armor was piled up throughout the stone chamber. The walls around the stone chamber were covered with standard long knives and spears. More than many years later, there was still no trace of rust on these weapons and armors, and they shone with a cold light under the reflection of the night pearl on the top of the stone chamber.
Walking in the stone chamber, Sui Yuan felt as if the skin around him was being pointed at by countless weapons, and the goosebumps never stopped.
"Boom.
Boom.
. "
Not long after Sui Yuan arrived here, the sound of a heavy stone door rising suddenly came from the other side of the stone room. Sui Yuan was startled and turned his head to look, only to see a figure wrapped in black standing behind the stone door.
The man in black stared coldly at Sui Yuan in the stone chamber, with some doubts in his eyes, but more of them contained cold murderous intent.
After realizing the identity of the visitor and knowing that he was no match, Sui Yuan took a breath and straightened his back slightly, trying to make himself look less scared.
However, the man in black at the door obviously didn't care about this. He stood at the door and looked around. After confirming that Sui Yuan was the only one in the stone room, he walked directly towards Sui Yuan.
The footsteps of the man in black fell on the armor in the stone room, making a clicking sound, which hit Sui Yuan's heart like a drum beat.
"Who are you?"
Sui Yuan suppressed the fear in his heart and asked the man in black in front of him.
There was a tremor in his voice that he could hear.
However, the man in black on the opposite side did not answer. When he stepped within a foot in front of Sui Yuan, the man in black suddenly raised his hand and waved, and a cold light flashed in his sleeve. Sui Yuan only felt his eyes blurred. Before he could figure out what happened, his chest felt as if he had been hit by a huge rock, and he couldn't help but fly backwards.
His figure hit the armor behind him heavily. Sui Yuan felt a sweetness in his throat and couldn't help but spit out a stream of blood.
"Hmm!
? "
Seeing that Sui Yuan was not pierced to the chest and died, the man in black was obviously a little strange. His eyes swept over Sui Yuan's chest. Through the clothes, he could faintly see a dark pendant-like thing inside.
With a cold snort, before Sui Yuan could stand up, the figure in black suddenly accelerated forward, raised his hand and pressed down on Sui Yuan's chest.
Seeing that the situation was not good, Sui Yuan didn't know where he got the strength, and he used the lazy donkey roll commonly used in fights, and rolled towards the stone door that he came in from.
However, the difference in strength between the two sides was too great. The man in black was unable to hit a single blow. He tapped his foot lightly and flew past Sui Yuan again. When he raised his hand, two cold lights flew towards Sui Yuan's head, one from the left and the other from the right.
At this time, Sui Yuan was rolling on the ground and could not see the two sharp weapons flying towards him, but the cold wind behind his head made him subconsciously raise his head and only heard "ding ding"
After two sounds, Sui Yuan felt a pain behind his ear, and a stream of warm liquid flowed down.
Gritting his teeth, Sui Yuan knew with many years of street fighting experience that he was injured behind his ear, but the wound should not be serious, otherwise his head would not be so clear now.
In the crisis of life and death, Sui Yuan burst out at the fastest speed in his life and almost rolled to the door of the stone chamber.
Seeing the stone wall in front of him, Sui Yuan was confident that as long as he ran over, he could use the falling stone door to stop the man in black behind him for a moment, and then he would have a chance to escape from the pool.
However, just as Sui Yuan stepped through the stone door with his left foot, the cold wind started up again behind him.
Sui Yuan subconsciously turned around to avoid it, but out of the corner of his eye he caught a glimpse of a bright sword light sweeping from behind.
‘It’s over now!
’ This thought flashed through Sui Yuan’s mind, and then his chest felt like it was being hit by a giant lump again.As if struck by a stone, he couldn't help but spit out a stream of blood mist from his mouth, and placed his figure on the stone door on one side.
Looking at the man in black standing almost in front of him, Sui Yuan showed a sad smile, 'Sure enough, I will just be a beggar in this life, and I can't save it even if I get gold, silver and jewelry.
With this thought flashing through his mind, Sui Yuan took a deep breath and slowly closed his eyes.
At such a close distance, there was absolutely no possibility of escape.
